paite: Huan David bel Ramah a Naioth a pan atai a, Jonathan kiang ava tung hi. "Bang ka hih a ahia? Bang ahia ka tatsiatna? Na pa tung ah bang ahia ka hihkhelh, hichitak a hon thah atup maizen?" achi hi.
heading: Jonathan In David Apanpih

paite: Ama'n, "That lou e. Na si het kei ding. Ngai in, ka pa'n kei hon theisak lou in bangmah himhim lian in neu taleh, ahih ngei kei hi. Bang ding in ahia hiai thute kei ahon iim ding? Ahon iim kei hial ding," achi hi.

David in, "Na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang chih na pa'n atheichian mahmah ngal a, alungsim in, hiai zaw Jonathan in thei dah hen, huchi lou in zaw alungkham lo kha ding, chi ahi ding. Himahleh TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, sihna toh ka kikal uh kal khat lel ahi," chi in uangtak in agen hi.
Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Na hinna in adeih peuhpeuh ka hon hihsak zel ding," achi hi.
David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Ngai in, zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Kumpipa kiang a ankuang um ngeingei ding ka hi. Himahleh ani thum ni nitaklam tanpha in gamlak a kibu ding in ka kuan zaw ding.
Na pa'n ka om louh lam ahon theihkhiakleh, David in akhua Bethlehem a va hoh zual ding hon ngen ngutngut a; a-inkuan ua dia kum teng a akithoih hun uh ahi," na chi in.
"Ahoih vo oi, achihleh na sikha alungmuang ding. Himahleh ahehleh thil hoih lou hih atum, chih thei mai in.

Huaiziak in na sikha hoihtak in hih in. Na sikha lah TOUPA thukhun ah na lutpihta ngal a. Himahleh tatsiatna nei ka hihleh nangmah in hon that mai in. Bangziak a na pa kiang a hon pi chitchiat ding na hia?" achi hi.
Jonathan in, "That lou e. Ka pa'n na tung a thil hoih lou hih atum chih ka theih peuhmah leh nang hilh lou in ka om mahmah dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Na pa'n hehngoh in hon na dawng taleh kua'n ahon hilh dia?" achi hi.
Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Pai dih, gamlak ah i va hoh peuhmah ding," achi hi. Huchi in gamlak ah ava hohkhawm uhi.

Jonathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA Israelte' Pathian atheihpihtu hi hen. Zingchiang hichih hun hiam, ani thum ni hiam a ka pa ka va dawp hun a, ngai in, David tungtang thu ahoih lam ahihleh na kiang a mi hon sawl in ka hong hilh kei dia hia?

Ka pa'n na tung ah thil hoih lou hih ut bang hitaleh, ka hon hilh louh a, lungmuangtak a na paitheihna dia ka hon khah keileh, TOUPA'N Jonathan abawlbawl in bawl henla, huai sang a thupi in leng. Ka pa kiang a a-om zel bang in TOUPA na kiang ah om hen.
Ka sihlouhna dia ka damsung kia a TOUPA hehpihna hon musak hilou in,
tangtawn in ka inkote leng na hehpih tawp ke'n. TOUPA'N David melma leitung a pan ahihman khit vek pha in leng tawp ke'n," achi hi.
Jonathan in David inkote toh thukhun bawl in, "David melmate khut tan in leng TOUPA'N phut hen," achi uhi.
Huchi in Jonathan in David akichiamsak nawn hi; amah hinna a-it bang geih in lah a-it ngal a.
Huchi in Jonathan in akiang ah, "Zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Na tutna avuak ding ziak in na om louh akilang ngei ding hi.
Ni thum na om nung in paisuk pah inla, tuma a thil ahong om lai a na kibukna mun ah hoh inla, Ezel suang chin ah ana om gige in.
Muitum bang in thaltang thum asik ah ka hon kapkhe ding hi.

Ngai in, kuan inla, thaltangte va mukhia in, chi in naupang ka sawl ding hi. Naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na nunglam ah a-om, la inla hong pai in, ka chihleh TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, nang a ding in agalmuanhuai in lauh ding om lou ahi ding.
Himahleh naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na pamlam ah a-om uh, ka chihleh paimang mai in. TOUPA'N ahon paimangsak ahi ding.
Nang leh ke'n thil i gensa tungthu ah ngai in, nang toh i kikal ah TOUPA a-om tawntung hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in David gamlak ah akibu a; kha ahong thak a, kumpipa ankuang um in atu hi.
Hun dang a atutna ngei bang in atutna ah kumpipa atu hi. Jonathan adingh a, Saul kiang ah Abner atu a; David mun bel avuak hi.
Himahleh Saul in huai ni in bangmah agen kei, "Atung ah thil banghiam a-om a, siang lou hiam ahi ding, siang lou ahi ngei ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, khadet zing ani nih ni in David mun avuak lailai hi. Huchi in Saul in atapa Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang achia Jesse tapa zan leh tuni a ankuang um dia hong pai lou ahia?" achi hi.
Jonathan in Saul adawng a, "David in Bethlehem a hoh ding ahon ngen ngutngut hi.

Hon hohsak teitei in, ka inkote'n khua ah kithoihna nei ding in ahon thukhak tinten uh. Huchi in na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh hon hohsak inla, ka unaute ka va veh ding, achi hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa dohkan ah ahong kei hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Jonathan tung ah Saul aheh guih a, akiang ah, "Nang, numei genhak leh helhat tapa, Jesse tapa na zahlakna ding leh na nu vuaktanna zahlaksak ding in na tel chih thei lou hon sa na hi hiam?
Jesse tapa hiai a a-om sung teng hihkip na hi kei dia, na gam leng. Huaiziak in samsak pah inla, ka kiang ah hon pisak in, asih ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.
Jonathan in apa Saul adawng a, akiang ah, "Bang ding in maw thah ding ahih? Bang ahih a ahia?" achi hi.
Saul in thah tum in teipi in akhoh a, huchi in Jonathan in apa'n David thah atum ngei, chih achian hi.
Jonathan bel dohkan a pan heh mahmah kawm in adingh a, huai kha ani nih ni in an a-um kei hi. Apa'n David azahlaksak mahmah ziak in alungkhampih hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang in Jonathan in naupang khat pi in gamlak ah David toh amun sehsa uah ahoh uhi.
Anaupang kiang ah, "Tai inla, ka thaltang kapkhiakte va zong in," achi hi. Naupang atai lai in, apam lam ah thaltang akap hi.
Jonathan in akapkiakna mun a naupang ava tun in Jonathan in naupang asam a, "Thaltang na pamlam ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Jonathan in anaupang asam a, "Hong pai meng in, kin in, zekai ke'n,” achi hi. Jonathan naupang in thaltangte atawmkhawm a, apu kiang ah ahong paita hi.
Himahleh, naupang in bangmah athei kei, Jonathan leh David kia in thil omdan athei uhi.
Jonathan in anaupang kiang ah athal leh avante apia a, akiang ah, "Pai inla, khua ah ana paipih in," achi hi.
Jonathan in apaitak in David omna mun simlam pang a pan adingh a, amai a lei si in thumvei akunsuk a, akitawptuah ua, akikahkhum ua, David anak kahzaw hi.

Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in aw, nang toh kei kikal ah leh ka suante leh na suante kikal ah tangtawn in TOUPA om hen, chi in TOUPA min in i kichiam tuak khinta hi,” achi hi. Huchi in adingh a, apaita a, khua ah Jonathan alutta hi.
